messages.subject: Project Lyra – executed MSSA
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Thank you both — the Master Software and Services Agreement is now executed by counterpart, dated 12 December 2025 and effective 1 January 2026. The executed PDF is attached for your records. Verdant will begin mobilisation under SOW-1 in the new year.

It's been a pleasure working with everyone on Lyra.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
